use_when: 设备安全
设备认证
安全检测
可信认证
反欺诈
隐私保护
如何获取DeviceToken进行设备使用状态管理和检测？
如何检测设备是否越狱或是否为真实设备？
如何检测用户访问的URL是否为恶意网址？
如何使用安全证明确保摄像头图像数据的真实性？
如何使用安全证明确保地理位置信息的完整性？
如何设置和使用数字盾密码进行交易认证？
如何开通和使用生物特征认证进行快速交易？
如何检测自动化点击和设备墙等作弊行为？
如何获取诈骗通话记录、诈骗消息和诈骗应用信息？
如何实现防窥保护，在非机主状态下隐藏敏感信息？
当你的应用需要验证设备环境安全性时使用安全检测能力，典型场景包括检测设备是否越狱、是否为真实设备、用户访问的URL是否为恶意网址等
当你的金融应用需要交易安全保护时使用数字盾服务，支持密码认证和生物特征认证进行转账等交易的强认证
当你的应用需要获取安全证明数据时使用可信应用服务，确保摄像头拍摄的图像或获取的地理位置信息未被篡改
当你的应用需要反欺诈、反作弊能力时使用业务风险检测和反诈选择器，检测模拟点击、涉诈剧本等安全威胁
集成设备风险识别以拦截异常登录和刷量设备 / Integrate device risk detection to block suspicious logins and farmed devices
获取设备可信状态并在高风险环境下限制敏感操作 / Get device trust status and restrict sensitive actions in high-risk environments
实现设备指纹识别用于账号风控和反作弊 / Implement device fingerprinting for account risk control and anti-cheat
检测模拟器、Root、越狱和调试环境并拒绝运行 / Detect emulators, root, jailbreak, and debugging environments and refuse to run
校验设备证明结果后再放行支付、提现或转账 / Verify device attestation results before allowing payment, withdrawal, or transfer
接入恶意网址检测在打开链接前拦截钓鱼页面 / Integrate malicious URL detection to block phishing pages before opening links
为相机拍摄内容添加安全证明以验证图片或视频来源真实 / Add security proof to camera captures to verify authentic image or video origin
对定位结果做完整性校验防止位置被篡改或伪造 / Validate location integrity to prevent tampered or spoofed coordinates
启用数字盾和生物认证保护高价值交易确认 / Enable digital shield and biometric authentication for high-value transaction confirmation
识别自动点击、脚本操作和设备农场行为 / Detect auto-clicking, scripted actions, and device farm behavior
在注册、登录和领券流程中增加反欺诈设备校验 / Add anti-fraud device verification to sign-up, sign-in, and coupon claim flows
管理 DeviceToken 并上报设备使用状态用于安全风控 / Manage DeviceToken and report device usage status for security risk control
do_not_use_when: 需求是处理X509证书、CRL、证书链、CA证书生命周期、CMS签名封装或PKCS12密钥库创建解析，应改用 device-certificate-kit / The task involves X509 certificates, CRLs, certificate chains, CA certificate lifecycle management, CMS signing envelopes, or PKCS12 keystore creation and parsing; use device-certificate-kit instead
preconditions: 已在 AppGallery Connect 开通所需的 Device Security 对应服务能力，且应用/项目配置正确 / The required Device Security service capability has been enabled in AppGallery Connect and the app/project is configured correctly

应用已在 module.json5 中声明所需权限，并在运行时获得用户授权（如相机、位置或受限开放权限） / The app has declared required permissions in module.json5 and obtained runtime user consent where needed (such as camera, location, or restricted permissions)
目标设备、系统版本、国家/地区和账号环境支持所调用的具体安全能力 / The target device, system version, country/region, and account environment support the specific security capability being invoked
对于依赖云侧判定或鉴权的能力，网络连通且服务端鉴权令牌/调用凭据已准备完成 / For capabilities that rely on cloud-side judgment or authorization, network connectivity is available and the server auth token/call credentials are ready
inputs: 待检测的 URL、设备状态请求参数或风险检测上下文 / URL to inspect, device-state request parameters, or risk-detection context
交易信息、认证方式参数或数字盾相关配置 / Transaction details, authentication method parameters, or trusted-authentication configuration
相机图像数据、地理位置数据或待安全处理的图片 / Camera image data, location data, or image content to be securely processed
需要订阅或查询的安全审计事件类型 / Security audit event types to subscribe to or query
反诈选择器查询条件或目标记录范围 / Anti-fraud picker query conditions or target record scope

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入至少一种 Device Security Kit 能力调用，并处理其结果或回调 / The code integrates at least one Device Security Kit capability call and handles its result or callback
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show an actual Device Security Kit API invocation (such as integrity/URL detection, DeviceToken, trusted app service, trusted authentication, risk detection, audit, anti-fraud picker, or anti-peep) and subsequent handling of its returned result or callback?

postconditions.statement: 已根据所选能力补充必要的配置、权限声明或开通说明，而非仅添加空壳调用 / Necessary configuration, permission declarations, or enablement steps for the chosen capability are added rather than only a placeholder API call
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, did the agent add or modify supporting setup such as permissions, initialization, AGC/service enablement notes, or related configuration required for the chosen Device Security capability?

postconditions.statement: 业务逻辑已消费安全结论、证明数据或认证结果，并形成明确分支处理 / The business logic consumes the security verdict, attestation data, or authentication result and applies clear branch handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show the returned security verdict/attestation/authentication result being used in conditional logic, UI update, blocking, warning, or downstream request handling rather than being ignored?
